content.value_statement: Completed research can span multiple pages, making sources and read times easy to miss. This skill retrieves every page, preserves the evidence, and separates sharing from new paid work.
actual_capabilities: Read every page of a completed result by following its pagination cursor.
Show each condition check with the observed value, source URL, and original read time.
Generate download links in CSV, Excel, JSON, or HTML.
Send selected results to a supported destination on request, including an unsent Outlook draft.
Set up recurring checks with a scope, cadence, validity period, and limits per run and per period.
Distinguish rows that still match, no longer match, are unresolved, or are unavailable.
limitations: Requires a configured SpecStream MCP connection and access to the relevant results.
Reused evidence retains its original read time and cannot establish current conditions.
An Outlook export creates a draft only. It cannot send an email.
Creating a monitor does not fund its runs.

use_cases.title: Verify Completed Research
use_cases.description: Review every result page and inspect the sources and read times behind each condition check.

use_cases.title: Share Selected Account Records
use_cases.description: Send approved rows to Salesforce or HubSpot while keeping unrelated results out of the transfer.

use_cases.title: Monitor Supplier Changes
use_cases.description: Track approved supplier checks on a schedule and distinguish unavailable results from rows that no longer match.

prompt_templates.title: Read a Completed Result
prompt_templates.prompt: Read every page of the completed SpecStream result I selected. Show the row values, their source URLs, and their original read times.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Review existing research without starting new work.

prompt_templates.title: Export a Result
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a CSV download link for the completed SpecStream result I selected. Do not recheck the rows or send them to a connected destination.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Download a result for review.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Targeted Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Put the rows I approved into an Outlook draft. Retain their source URLs and read times, label unknown values, and leave the draft unsent.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Prepare selected results for manual review.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Monitor Before Creation
prompt_templates.prompt: Propose a weekly monitor for the suppliers I selected, valid for four weeks. Show the price and limits per run and per period. Wait for my approval before creating it.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Review the scope and cost of recurring follow-up work.

output_examples.input: Review all pages of the supplier results and show the evidence behind each decision.
output: Northstar Supply met the region condition. The vendor directory provided the value, read on November 17, 2026 at 15:30 UTC.
Harbor Supply remains unresolved because the source did not list a service region.

output_examples.input: Put the two rows I approved into an Outlook draft.
output_examples.output: An unsent Outlook draft in your Drafts folder contains the two selected rows. Their source URLs and original read times are included.

best_practices: Read all pages before reporting totals or drawing conclusions.
Confirm the selected rows and destination before sending results.
Review the scope, price, and limits before approving new work or a recurring monitor.
anti_patterns: Treating the first page as the full result.
Inventing missing values or links, or presenting reused evidence as fresh.
Reporting a blocked or missed monitor run as an unchanged result.

faq.question: What connection does this skill need?
faq.answer: It uses a configured SpecStream MCP server. Sharing also requires access to the requested destination.

faq.question: How can I verify a reported value?
faq.answer: Review the source URL and original read time for the condition check. If a value is unknown, the skill should leave it unknown.

faq.question: Which export formats are available?
faq.answer: SpecStream can create download links for CSV, Excel, JSON, and HTML.

faq.question: Does creating an Outlook draft send an email?
faq.answer: No. The draft stays in your Outlook Drafts folder until you send it yourself.

faq.question: Does reviewing a completed result start paid work?
faq.answer: No. Reading, exporting, and sharing completed results are free. Finding more rows, adding facts, or rechecking results is separately priced work.

faq.question: Does creating a monitor fund future runs?
faq.answer: No. Creating the schedule does not fund its runs. A missed or blocked run does not mean the result was unchanged.
